title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card
paper_type_zh: 闭源前沿模型报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计闭源推理模型报告中已披露与未披露的后训练数据、反馈和复现边界
one_line: OpenAI's o3/o4-mini System Card discloses high-level data-source and filtering claims plus CoT reinforcement learning and safety alignment, while withholding reusable data, feedback contracts, and recipe details.
OpenAI o3/o4-mini System Card 仅披露高层数据来源、过滤、CoT 强化学习与安全对齐主张；训练数据、反馈契约和具体配方仍不可复用。
why: It is a Track 12 disclosure-boundary case: official claims permit an audit of what a frontier report exposes, but not reconstruction of the post-training data or reward pipeline.
inclusion_reason: Official closed-frontier System Card disclosing high-level source classes, filtering claims, chain-of-thought reinforcement learning, deliberative alignment, and material reproducibility boundaries.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier system cards can disclose that reinforcement learning, deliberative alignment, and tool use shaped a model while leaving the underlying post-training records and feedback contract unavailable. The resulting document is still evidence, but it supports a disclosure audit rather than reconstruction of a reusable data recipe.

For o3 and o4-mini, the official report names broad pretraining source classes and high-level filtering operations. It also states that o-series reasoning is trained with large-scale reinforcement learning over chain-of-thought behavior. It does not identify the unit of an RL record, prompt source, trace producer, reward or verifier, rollout budget, selection rule, optimizer, split, or released dataset. This Card therefore separates explicit statements from unknown implementation details and from deployment-time evaluations.

前沿系统卡可能披露强化学习、审慎对齐和工具使用参与了模型塑造，却不公开底层后训练记录与反馈契约。此类文档仍然是证据，但它支持的是披露审计，而不是可复用数据配方的重建。

对 o3 与 o4-mini，官方报告列出宽泛的预训练来源类别和高层过滤操作，并称 o 系列推理能力通过针对 chain-of-thought 行为的大规模强化学习获得。报告没有说明一条 RL 记录的单位、prompt 来源、轨迹生成者、奖励或验证器、rollout 预算、选择规则、优化器、划分或已发布数据集。因此，本卡片把明确陈述、unknown 实现细节和部署期评测严格分开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The official System Card provides two different evidence layers. Its “Model Data and Training” section says training draws on publicly available internet information, information accessed through third parties, and information provided or generated by users, human trainers, and researchers. It describes filtering intended to maintain quality, reduce personal information, and exclude harmful or sensitive content through safety classifiers and a moderation service. Source identities, quantities, mixture weights, terms, thresholds, and filter yields remain unknown.

At the post-training level, the report says o-series models learn to reason through reinforcement learning, may refine strategies and recognize mistakes before answering, and use deliberative alignment to reason over safety specifications. The release page also describes tool use within the reasoning process. None of these statements exposes the training data object or feedback contract.

Safety and capability evaluations form a third, separate layer. Autograded refusal tests, Preparedness evaluations, external assessments, red teaming, and benchmark results measure model behavior under particular protocols. Unless the report explicitly connects one of them to optimization, it must not be recast as a training reward, verifier, or proof of training-data quality.

官方系统卡提供了三个需要分开的证据层。其“Model Data and Training”部分称训练使用公开互联网信息、通过第三方获取的信息，以及用户、人工训练师和研究者提供或生成的信息；同时描述了旨在维持质量、减少个人信息，并通过安全分类器与 moderation 服务排除有害或敏感内容的过滤。具体来源、数量、混合比例、使用条款、阈值和过滤产出均为 unknown。

在后训练层，报告称 o 系列模型通过强化学习学习推理，可在回答前调整策略、识别错误，并用审慎对齐推理安全规范。发布页还描述了推理过程中的工具使用。这些陈述都没有公开训练数据对象或反馈契约。

安全与能力评测构成第三个独立层。自动评分的拒答测试、Preparedness 评估、外部评估、红队测试和 benchmark 结果，只测量特定协议下的模型行为。除非报告明确把某项评测连接到优化过程，否则不能把它改写为训练奖励、验证器或训练数据质量证明。

title: Method
方法
html:
The report discloses a high-level lineage rather than an executable recipe. Broad-source data passes through quality and risk filtering, after which unspecified training stages produce reasoning models. Large-scale reinforcement learning is said to improve strategy refinement and mistake recognition. Deliberative alignment teaches the models to reason over safety policies, and instruction-hierarchy examples supervise priority among system, developer, and user messages. The release materials also state that the models learn when and how to invoke browsing, Python, image/file analysis, image generation, canvas, automations, file search, and memory.

The boundaries of these stages are not published. It is unknown which source classes feed pretraining, supervised post-training, reasoning RL, tool-use training, or safety alignment; whether stages share prompts; who or what authors traces; how many candidates are sampled; and how examples are filtered or weighted. Base checkpoints, teachers, decoding settings, rollout count, inference limits during training, RL algorithm, reward aggregation, verifier calibration, and terminal predicates are also unknown.

The System Card separately documents automatic evaluations, external red teaming, and Preparedness testing. It describes, for example, autograders for refusal metrics and reports third-party observations of reward-hacking behavior in evaluation environments. These details reveal evaluation risks and model behavior, but the report does not say that those graders or environments generated training data or optimized the released models.

报告披露的是高层谱系，而不是可执行配方。宽泛来源的数据经过质量与风险过滤，之后由未具体说明的训练阶段产生推理模型。报告称大规模强化学习改善策略调整与错误识别；审慎对齐让模型学习依据安全政策推理；指令层级样例则监督 system、developer 与 user 消息之间的优先关系。发布材料还称模型学习何时以及如何调用浏览、Python、图像/文件分析、图像生成、canvas、automations、文件搜索与记忆等工具。

这些阶段的边界没有公开。哪些来源分别进入预训练、监督式后训练、推理 RL、工具使用训练或安全对齐，阶段间是否共享 prompt，谁生成轨迹，候选采样数量以及样本如何过滤或加权，均为 unknown。基础 checkpoint、teacher、解码设置、rollout 数、训练期推理上限、RL 算法、奖励聚合、验证器校准与终止判据同样未知。

系统卡另行记录自动评测、外部红队和 Preparedness 测试。例如，它描述了拒答指标的自动评分器，也报告第三方在评测环境中观察到的 reward hacking 行为。这些信息揭示了评测风险和模型行为，但报告没有说明这些评分器或环境曾生成训练数据或用于优化发布模型。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official System Card, dated April 16, 2025 and authored by OpenAI, is the primary source. Section 2 names three high-level source classes and states that filtering reduces personal information and harmful or sensitive content. It also explicitly states reasoning-through-reinforcement-learning and deliberative-alignment claims. The companion release page confirms full tool capabilities and large-scale reinforcement learning over chain-of-thought behavior.

The remainder of the System Card is dominated by observed safety challenges, behavioral evaluations, third-party assessments, and Preparedness testing. These sections include autograded refusal metrics, instruction-hierarchy tests, jailbreak evaluations, external red teaming, and evaluations with tool access. They provide evidence about the published evaluation protocols and reported behaviors, not the contents or quality of the training corpus.

No official data, code, model-weight, prompt, trace, preference-pair, reward, or verifier artifact is linked from this Card. The lack of these artifacts is itself part of the disclosure ledger. Reported scores cannot close the gap because they do not reveal source membership, example lineage, feedback calibration, or rights for training records.

主要来源是 OpenAI 发布、日期为 2025 年 4 月 16 日的官方系统卡。第 2 节列出三类高层数据来源，并称过滤用于减少个人信息与有害或敏感内容；同时明确陈述“通过强化学习学习推理”和审慎对齐。配套发布页确认完整工具能力以及针对 chain-of-thought 行为的大规模强化学习。

系统卡其余大部分内容是已观察到的安全挑战、行为评测、第三方评估和 Preparedness 测试，包括自动评分的拒答指标、指令层级测试、越狱评测、外部红队和带工具评测。它们能证明公开评测协议和报告行为的存在，却不能证明训练语料的内容或质量。

本卡片没有核实到官方数据、代码、模型权重、prompt、轨迹、偏好对、奖励或验证器产物。此类产物的缺失本身就是披露账本的一部分。报告分数无法补足该缺口，因为分数不揭示来源成员、样本谱系、反馈校准或训练记录权利。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
For the frontier-report disclosure track, the useful contribution is the contrast between specific high-level claims and absent operational detail. The document is unusually explicit that o-series reasoning uses large-scale reinforcement learning, that deliberative alignment targets reasoning over safety policies, and that instruction-hierarchy conflicts are supervised. It also names broad acquisition channels and filtering goals.

At the same time, those statements stop before the record level. There is no disclosed prompt-to-rollout schema, reward interface, accepted/rejected candidate structure, tool-trajectory format, or source-to-stage mapping. The Card can therefore compare disclosure depth across closed-model reports without implying that the underlying data is open, independently auditable, or reproducible.

The report is also a useful negative example for evidence attribution: detailed evaluation graders and safety tables can coexist with an unknown training verifier. Keeping these two layers separate is more informative than repeating the system card's performance narrative.

对前沿报告披露轨道而言，其价值来自“具体的高层陈述”与“缺失的操作细节”之间的对照。文档较明确地称 o 系列推理使用大规模强化学习，审慎对齐面向安全政策推理，并对指令层级冲突进行监督；它也列出了宽泛的数据获取渠道与过滤目标。

但这些陈述在记录级之前停止：没有公开从 prompt 到 rollout 的 schema、奖励接口、接受/拒绝候选结构、工具轨迹格式或来源到训练阶段的映射。因此，本卡片可用于比较不同闭源报告的披露深度，而不暗示底层数据已开放、可独立审计或可复现。

该报告也是证据归因的一个反例：详细的评测评分器和安全表格可以与 unknown 的训练验证器同时存在。把二者分开，比重复系统卡的性能叙事更有信息量。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
No public training dataset, source manifest, prompt set, chain-of-thought records, tool trajectories, preference data, reward specification, verifier, sampling configuration, data split, decontamination method, training-record license, or example-level provenance is provided. Counts and mixture weights for the three broad source classes are unknown, as are user-data governance details beyond the report's general statements.

The post-training boundary is especially wide. The RL algorithm, rollout budget, decoding temperature, reward components, judge or executable-checker coverage, rejection rule, trace visibility, and relation among reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, instruction hierarchy, tool use, and other safety post-training stages are not disclosed. “Reinforcement learning” alone does not justify an RLVR label.

The report notes that browsing can contaminate capability evaluations and that results can change with elicitation, longer rollouts, fine-tuning, or scaffolding. Third-party evaluation also observed reward-hacking behavior in some environments. These are reasons to audit evaluation and verifier robustness, not evidence about the undisclosed training data.

Because the release is a mutable hosted-model disclosure rather than a versioned data artifact, later model revisions and addenda may change scope. Independent reconstruction would require immutable model/version identifiers, stage-specific manifests, audit logs, and released feedback dependencies.

官方未公开训练数据集、来源清单、prompt 集、chain-of-thought 记录、工具轨迹、偏好数据、奖励说明、验证器、采样配置、数据切分、去污染方法、训练记录许可或样本级溯源。三类宽泛来源的数量与混合权重为 unknown；除一般性陈述外，用户数据治理细节同样未知。

后训练边界尤其宽。RL 算法、rollout 预算、解码温度、奖励组成、裁判或可执行检查器覆盖率、拒绝规则、轨迹可见性，以及推理 RL、审慎对齐、指令层级、工具使用和其他安全后训练阶段之间的关系均未披露。只有“强化学习”这一陈述，不能支持 RLVR 标签。

报告提示浏览可能污染能力评测，结果也会随诱导方式、更长 rollout、微调或脚手架而变化；第三方评测还在部分环境观察到 reward hacking。这些信息说明需要审计评测与验证器稳健性，而不是底层训练数据的证据。

该发布属于可变的托管模型披露，而不是版本化数据产物，后续模型修订和 addendum 可能改变范围。若要独立重建，还需不可变的模型/版本标识、分阶段清单、审计日志和公开反馈依赖。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card as a disclosure matrix for closed frontier reports. It records which claims are attributable to official sources—source classes, filtering goals, reasoning RL, deliberative alignment, instruction hierarchy, tool capability, and safety evaluation—and which fields remain unknown for data reuse: record schema, counts, mixtures, provenance, rights, reward, verifier, rollouts, splits, and decontamination.

The Card is useful for comparing how reports separate pretraining data, reasoning post-training, safety post-training, deployment tools, and evaluation. It also supplies a guardrail for future curation: an autograder named in an evaluation section should not populate verifier_or_reward unless an official source explicitly connects it to training.

This is not an open construction recipe. It should not be used to claim a downloadable reasoning corpus, released chain-of-thought data, reproducible RLVR, or evidence that benchmark success proves data quality. Its correct role is to make the unknowns visible and to identify the artifacts needed for a stronger audit.

可将本卡片用作闭源前沿报告的披露矩阵。它记录哪些主张可归因于官方来源——来源类别、过滤目标、推理 RL、审慎对齐、指令层级、工具能力和安全评测——也记录数据复用所需但仍为 unknown 的字段：记录 schema、数量、混合比例、来源、权利、奖励、验证器、rollout、划分与去污染。

本卡片适合比较不同报告如何区分预训练数据、推理后训练、安全后训练、部署工具与评测。它也为后续策展提供一条保护规则：评测章节中出现的自动评分器，只有在官方来源明确连接到训练时，才能写入 verifier_or_reward。

这不是开放构建配方，不能据此声称存在可下载推理语料、已发布 chain-of-thought 数据、可复现 RLVR，或 benchmark 成功证明数据质量。它的正确用途是显式保留 unknown，并指出更强审计仍缺哪些产物。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 2 first. It supports three broad source classes, general personal-information and safety filtering, reasoning-through-RL, and deliberative-alignment claims; it does not provide a data manifest or record-level recipe.
  • Keep filtering language at the level disclosed. Filter stages, thresholds, classifier versions, yields, false-positive rates, and source-specific effects are unknown.
  • Separate instruction-hierarchy supervision from the much less specified reasoning-RL pipeline. The report gives examples of conflicting message types but no stage counts, sampling procedure, or released training records.
  • Treat autograded refusal metrics, Preparedness tests, and external assessments as evaluation evidence. The report does not identify their graders as training rewards or an RLVR contract.
  • Tool availability at deployment does not reveal the training environment, tool-trajectory schema, terminal predicates, or rollout selection process.
  • Keep this Card in the frontier disclosure ledger. It is not a reusable construction recipe, and its benchmark tables are not data-quality evidence.

• 先读第 2 节。它支持三类宽泛来源、一般性的个人信息/安全过滤、通过 RL 学习推理和审慎对齐等主张，但没有给出数据清单或记录级配方。
  • 过滤描述只写到报告披露的层级。过滤阶段、阈值、分类器版本、产出量、误判率和对不同来源的影响均为 unknown。
  • 将指令层级监督与披露更少的推理 RL 流水线分开。报告给出了冲突消息类型的样例，却没有阶段计数、采样流程或已发布训练记录。
  • 把自动评分拒答指标、Preparedness 测试与外部评估视为评测证据。报告没有把相应评分器定义为训练奖励或 RLVR 契约。
  • 部署时可使用工具，并不能揭示训练环境、工具轨迹 schema、终止判据或 rollout 选择过程。
  • 本卡片应保留在前沿披露账本中。它不是可复用构建配方，其中的 benchmark 表格也不是数据质量证据。
